# -list prints the mkfile's targets and variables instead of building.
# When stdout is not a terminal (as here) it is a plain list, one per line,
# for scripts and shell completion: targets, then variables as NAME=.
mk -list
cmp stdout plain.want
! stderr .

# a target or flag after -list does not build anything either
mk -list clean
cmp stdout plain.want

-- mkfile --
CC ?= gcc ## C compiler
PREFIX = /usr/local ## Install location
OBJ = main.o util.o

all:V: prog ## Build everything

prog: $OBJ ## The program
	$CC -o $target $prereq

# Not a description: a comment on its own line.
test:V: prog
	./prog --test

clean:V: ## Remove build output
	rm -f prog *.o

%.o: %.c
	$CC -c $stem.c

hello-%:V: ## Greet someone
	echo hello $stem

prog: config.h
-- plain.want --
all
prog
test
clean
CC=
PREFIX=
OBJ=
